current.text: He is a rookie. The Lakers traded up one spot in the draft to get him.
In summer league he took almost 7 threes a game but shot 42% from the field, 29% from three and 73% from the line, and added little else.
He is not in the projected Lakers starting lineup of Doncic, Reaves, Grimes, Thybulle and Kessler.
Experts expect a bench role of 12 to 16 minutes and little production early. He should not impact most fantasy leagues this season.
His Yahoo status is questionable with an undisclosed issue.

durable.text: He is a very long guard. In summer league he showed he can block shots, including jump shots.

Experts like his outlier athleticism, defense and shooting upside. They see a guard who can hit threes, block shots and get steals, with some assist and scoring potential, and a good fit next to Doncic and Reaves.
